import java.util.Scanner;

public class Solution {
    public void run() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        if (n > m) {
            int temp = n;
            n = m;
            m = temp;
        }
        int res = (n * m) / 2;
        int adjusted = adjust(n, m, res);
        System.out.println(adjusted * 2);
    }

    private int adjust(int n, int m, int res) {
        if (n == 1 && (m % 6 == 2 || m % 6 == 3 || m % 6 == 4)) {
            return res - 1;
        }
        if (n == 2) {
            if (m == 2) return 0;
            if (m == 3) return 2;
            if (m == 7) return 6;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Solution().run();
    }
}
